title: Which country makes the most MLB players? Per person, it's Curaçao
description:
Nearly one in ten Major League players on 2026 Opening Day rosters was born in the Dominican Republic: 93 of 948. Then Venezuela 60, Cuba 20, Canada 19, Japan and Puerto Rico 14 each. Per person, Curaçao leads: 4 players from about 156,000 people, one in every 39,000, about three times the Dominican rate.

Sources:
- Opening Day rosters feature 249 internationally born players (26 March 2026) — Major League Baseball: https://www.mlb.com/press-release/press-release-opening-day-rosters-feature-249-internationally-born-players
- Population, total (SP.POP.TOTL), 2024 — World Bank World Development Indicators: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/DOM;VEN;CUB;CAN;JPN;PRI;MEX;CUW;PAN;COL;KOR;ABW;BHS;HND;NIC/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?date=2024&format=json&per_page=50
